scope: Eight existing synthetic smoke cases × economy, strong, router; no human bank or participants.

unchanged.masking: existing local CPU detector identity; no external masking destination

request_contract.metadata: provider_metadata or providerMetadata; gateway.cost validated and used as provider_reported; routing fields if supplied must name typesafe-ai/jev and typesafe-ai
request_contract.immutable_underlying_version: not exposed; responding alias alone cannot detect a provider changing the model behind that alias
request_contract.ledger_metadata: normalized model_effective, cost_kind, token counts and request_id preserved; full Gateway routing/generationId are not persisted by chat_service

budget_reasoning.limitation: The tariff calculation is not an invoice or provider-enforced spend cap. Unexpected billed cost is retained; unknown outcomes keep the full reservation and stop further calls.
budget_reasoning.direct_provider_or_new_destinations: not permitted by this Gateway proposal

catalog.limitation: Catalog flags are provider claims. No zero-retention guarantee is inferred.

official_sources.supports: Exact compatible endpoint, Gateway Bearer authentication, model alias, noul and snake-case usage, gateway cost metadata.
The only provider filter constrains serving providers.
Evaluation fallback is opt-in and bills both stages; no fallback is enabled here.
Exact catalog tariff and context/token metadata; public read-only lookup, no inference.

root_actions_before_live_run: Apply this delta to the smoke-only manifest and refresh source_sha256 after the code is fixed.
Bind the actual human authorization and <=24h window to the exact new manifest hash; maximum 1 USD; accept mutable aliases explicitly in the recorded scope.
Use only the existing DeepSeek and Gateway credentials through the isolated child environment; no TypeSafe direct key or new credit purchase.
Freeze code SHA; finish all five required gates and read-only preflight.
Run through the unchanged shared ledger. Retain every error/unknown reservation. On timeout, provider/model drift, exceeded bound or revocation stop without automatic retry.
Recovery requires reviewing ledger and provider evidence; never delete/reset uncertain entries to reclaim budget.
